Magnesium

280 mg day−1 in women. However, it is possible that the recommended intakes are set somewhat high, as clinical problems are
uncommon when such intakes are not caused or accompanied by metabolic diseases such as diabetes and alcoholism.
Conclusion
Based on evidence of low Mg intake in industrialized countries, intervention studies are needed to test whether improving Mg status
would improve health outcomes.
